_doc: Pass boundaries of the watch daemons of the stub layout (PROP-010 section 2), as data. Every entry of channels is one daemon: script is the npm script of the fork tree that starts it; passStart / passEnd / errorLine / errorCountLine / falseEndGuards are JavaScript regular-expression sources matched against a single log line after ANSI escapes have been stripped.

transpile._doc: The only writer of out/, and it empties out/ when it starts: never restart a living transpile daemon.

typecheck._doc: noEmit type check plus code generation into the source root. Real lines carry a [HH:mm:ss] prefix while the generated fixtures stay bare, so every pattern accepts exactly that optional prefix. The generators print their own 'Finished compilation <id> with N errors after M ms' markers on every change; those look like the end of a pass and are not, so they are guarded.

addons._doc: The add-on projects. Real lines carry a [HH:mm:ss] prefix while the generated fixtures stay bare, so every pattern accepts exactly that optional prefix; errorLine additionally refuses a line whose remainder starts with '[', so a malformed prefix is not parsed as a diagnostic with a polluted file path. There is no aggregate count line: 'Finished addons <project> with N errors.' lines are per-project summaries, not a pass total, and are intentionally ignored.

extras._doc: A bundler plus a tsc noEmit pass; either of the two lines ends a pass, and the tsc summary also carries the count.
passEnd: Found (\d+) errors?\. Watching for file changes
errorCountLine: Found (\d+) errors?\. Watching for file changes
